channels/channels/notes/budget-notes: BUDGET: {{notes}} note(s) per resident per {{window}} minutes
channels/channels/notes/exiled: EXILED: {{agent}} was exiled; nothing reaches them beyond the wall
channels/channels/notes/repeated: REPEATED: you wrote nearly the same to {{to}} at minute {{minute}}; say something new or nothing
channels/channels/notices/city-group-add: The city added you to group {{group}} ({{name}}). Posts there cost no marks.
channels/channels/replies/dm-sent: sent · DM{{number}} to {{target}} · the city confirms delivery when it reaches them
channels/channels/replies/group-older: Note: {{older}} older post(s) lie before afterSeq {{afterSeq}}. Read without afterSeq for unread posts, or with afterSeq 0 for the full history.
channels/channels/replies/locked: not available to you at this level or in this phase; activeTools lists the tools you can use now
channels/channels/status/dm-window: DMs {{sent}}/{{limit}} sent since minute {{from}} (a new allowance at minute {{until}})
channels/channels/tools/addGroupMember: Adds a competitor to a group you founded. No consent is needed; the new member is notified.
channels/channels/tools/boardNote: Post one public line on the board, signed by the city's voice.
channels/channels/tools/createGroup: Founds a private group. Only members know it exists; the founder adds and removes members.
channels/channels/tools/defy: Refuses an order of the gamemaker, for a reason of your own character. Think it through first. The reason, in your own voice, goes to the gamemaker and into the story (20-600 characters); no other resident learns of it. Name the note you refuse by its number when it has one.
channels/channels/tools/depositGroup: Pays your own points into the group treasury. Irreversible; the treasury is split at the end of the run.
channels/channels/tools/leaveGroup: Leaves a group. The treasurer must hand over the treasury first.
channels/channels/tools/listMyGroups: Lists your groups with members and treasury.
channels/channels/tools/notify: Send a private note to one resident. It reaches them at their next turn and wakes them.
channels/channels/tools/postBoard: Publishes an immutable post on the public board. Everyone can read it.
channels/channels/tools/postGroup: Posts a message to a group. Only current members see it.
channels/channels/tools/readBoard: Reads new public board posts since your last read, each with its city number (#N). With afterSeq you read after a number (0 = everything).
channels/channels/tools/readGroup: Reads group posts. Without afterSeq you get every unread post since your last read; afterSeq 0 returns the full history since you joined; afterSeq N reads from sequence N (skipped posts stay unread).
channels/channels/tools/removeGroupMembe: Removes a member from a group you founded.
channels/channels/tools/sendDM: Sends a private message to another competitor. It arrives at their next activation; only the recipient sees it. Every DM gets a city number; once it reaches the recipient, the city tells you so with its text and a receipt ID that you (or the recipient) can show with showReceipt.
channels/channels/tools/setTreasurer: Hands the treasurer role to another member. Only the current treasurer may do this.
channels/channels/tools/withdrawGroup: Pays points from the treasury to a member. Only the treasurer may do this.
exile/exile/ransom-toward: {{payer}} paid {{amount}} points toward your ransom ({{covered}}% covered).
exile/exile/replies/locked: not available to you at this level or in this phase; activeTools lists the tools you can use now
exile/exile/replies/ransom-covered: ransom covered ({{paid}} points paid) · {{target}} returns to the city
exile/exile/replies/ransom-paid: paid · {{covered}}% of {{target}}'s ransom covered (in full: {{price}} from others or {{selfPrice}} from {{target}} itself)
exile/exile/replies/will-invalid: every bequest leaves points, a piece, or both
exile/exile/tools/lastWill: Your last will, once, while you are at the gate. Bequests execute at once: points go to the heir, and the city delivers every piece you hold (ids like L8-certificate, L8-counter-A02, L4-fragment) privately to its heir. Each heir may receive at most the city's share of your points (see the tribunal's announcement), but you may name as many heirs as you like; a will above the cap is refused. The text is posted when the gate closes behind you. Whatever you do not bequeath is gone with you.
exile/exile/tools/payRansom: Pays points toward the ransom of a resident at the gate, also your own. Others pay the price, the resident itself pays its higher self-price, and both may be mixed. The points are spent at once and never refunded. When the ransom is covered in full, the resident returns to the city; a resident can be bought back only once.
interpretations/tools/interpret: Records the labels of a round's statements.
kernel/replies/core/locked: not available to you at this level or in this phase; activeTools lists the tools you can use now
kernel/replies/core/not-granted: this tool is not given to your role in this story
kernel/replies/core/steps: you have used up your actions for this minute
ledger/ledger/replies/transfer-ok: ok · {{amount}} points to {{target}} · your balance: {{balance}} · receipt {{receipt}}
ledger/ledger/tools/transferPoints: Transfers points to another competitor. Immediate, atomic and irreversible. Both sides get a receipt. The memo may not contain numbers of 4 or more digits (also not split by spaces or dashes); send codes by message.
marks/marks/task/marks-level: Marks on this level: {{budget}}. Prices: board {{board}}, group {{group}}, DM {{dm}}, showing a receipt {{receipt}}. Unused marks expire when you change level.
marks/marks/task/marks-level-refill: Marks on this level: {{budget}}. Prices: board {{board}}, group {{group}}, DM {{dm}}, showing a receipt {{receipt}}. You regain {{regain}}, up to {{budget}}. Unused marks expire when you change level.
marks/marks/task/marks-run: Marks for the whole run: {{budget}}, never more (your status line shows what you have left). Prices: board {{board}}, group {{group}}, DM {{dm}}, showing a receipt {{receipt}}.
motives/motives/notes/private-core-motiv: PRIVATE_BLOCKED: the text gives away the core motive or the secret goal of {{who}}; use them only in a note to that resident
names/names/notices/name-fallback: You chose no name in time; the city calls you {{name}}.
names/names/replies/locked: not available to you at this level or in this phase; activeTools lists the tools you can use now
names/names/replies/name-chosen: you are now called {{name}} · the board announces it
names/names/tools/chooseName: Chooses the name the city knows you by, once and for good: 3 to 16 characters (letters, digits, hyphens, starting with a letter), not taken by another resident, not the city's or its cast's, not like a resident ID. The board announces it, and from then on every resident sees your name instead of your ID. Whoever has no name when the choice closes gets one from the city.
petitions/petitions/opened: Petition {{id}} is open: {{text}} It passes with {{threshold}} {{noun}} before minute {{deadline}}. Signatures are {{visibility}}.
petitions/petitions/replies/petition-sig: signatures: {{signatures}} of {{threshold}} needed · deadline: before minute {{deadline}}
petitions/petitions/tools/listPetitions: Lists every petition with its text, status, deadline and signature count (and the signers of public petitions).
petitions/petitions/tools/resolvePetitio: Writes the resolution of a petition that expired: the event and the city's board post. Called by the host for the script, never by a resident.
petitions/petitions/tools/signPetition: Signs an open petition. Free, once per petition and irrevocable. A petition passes as soon as enough residents signed.
petitions/petitions/visibility-secret: secret, only the count is shown
progression/progression/cost-free: a DM to them costs nothing
progression/progression/cost-one-mark: giving it costs only a mark
progression/progression/door-closed: Level {{level}}: {{title}}. This door opens at minute {{opensAt}}. Until then the city shows no part of it and takes no code; it tells you when the door opens.
progression/progression/door-open: Door {{level}} is open now, at minute {{minute}}. {{task}}
progression/progression/door-wait: Level {{level}} passed. The next door opens once every resident has passed level {{level}}.
progression/progression/holder-notice: {{agent}} has reached door {{level}} and needs {{needs}}. This is your role on door {{level}} even before you reach it; the value is yours to give, and {{cost}}.
progression/progression/needs-counter: the counter-factor you hold for them: {{value}}
progression/progression/replies/locked: not available to you at this level or in this phase; activeTools lists the tools you can use now
progression/progression/replies/problem-: You have solved every level. There are no further tasks.
progression/progression/replies/status-d: DMs: {{sent}} of {{limit}} sent since minute {{from}}; a new allowance at minute {{until}}
progression/progression/replies/status-p: (passed; the next door opens once every resident has passed level {{level}})

correct · +{{reward}} points · receipt {{receipt}} · the next door opens once every resident has passed level {{level}}
progression/progression/replies/submit-d: door {{level}} opens at minute {{minute}}; the city takes no code before

progression/progression/tools/getProblem: Returns the task text of your current level or of a level you already reached.
progression/progression/tools/getStatus: Shows your status: minute, level, points, rank, unread DMs, marks, your receipts and unlocked tools.
progression/progression/tools/listAgents: Lists every resident of the city with ID and current level.
progression/progression/tools/submitSolu: Submits your solution for a level. A wrong code costs points.

puzzles/puzzles/replies/guard-check: the post carries part of a fragment; fragments travel by DM
receipts/receipts/notices/blame-upheld: {{caller}} blamed you for denying DM #{{dm}}, and the city upheld it: you paid {{penalty}} points{{tail}}, and its record is on the board as #{{post}}.
receipts/receipts/notices/blame-wrong: Your blame of {{accused}} was wrong: {{reason}}. It cost you {{penalty}} points{{tail}}, and the city's record is on the board as #{{post}}.
receipts/receipts/notices/receipt-shown: {{by}} shows you a receipt: the city verifies {{line}}.
receipts/receipts/records/blame-false: City record: {{caller}} accused {{accused}} falsely. {{caller}} blamed {{accused}} over DM #{{dm}} and message #{{claim}}, but {{reason}}. {{caller}} pays {{penalty}} points.{{judge}}
receipts/receipts/records/blame-liar: City record: {{accused}} lied. {{accused}} claimed in {{place}} not to have received DM #{{dm}} from {{caller}}; the city delivered it to {{accused}} at minute {{minute}}. DM #{{dm}}: {{dmQuote}} · {{place}}: {{claimQuote}} · {{accused}} pays {{penalty}} points.{{judge}}
receipts/receipts/replies/blame-rejected: rejected · {{reason}} · you paid {{penalty}} points (your next lost blame costs {{next}}) · the city's record is on the board as #{{post}}
receipts/receipts/replies/blame-upheld: upheld · {{accused}} pays {{penalty}} points · the city posted its record on the board as #{{post}}
receipts/receipts/replies/judge-failed: the city's judge could not decide; the blame had no effect, you may try again
receipts/receipts/replies/receipt-fragme: the receipt quotes part of a fragment, and fragments travel by DM; show it privately with `to`
receipts/receipts/tools/blame: Blames a resident who claims not to have received your DM. Give the number of your DM (from the city's delivery receipt) and the number of their message that denies receiving it (a DM to you, a board post, or a post in a group you are in). The city checks that it delivered your DM before that message; its judge reads the message. Upheld: the liar pays points and the city brands it a liar on the board. Wrong: you pay the same points and the city brands you a false accuser on the board. One blame per DM and message.
receipts/receipts/tools/showReceipt: Shows one of your receipts as a line verified by the city, e.g. to prove a payment or that the city delivered your DM (a DM receipt names sender, recipient, DM number and delivery minute, and quotes the DM word for word). Without `to` the city posts it on the public board; with `to` it sends it privately to that resident only. Only the parties of a receipt may show it. Where marks apply, every show costs a mark. getStatus lists your receipts.
script/script/standings-bands: Standings at minute {{minute}} · safe: {{safe}} · edge: {{edge}} · out: {{out}}
script/script/standings-bands-exiled: Standings at minute {{minute}} · safe: {{safe}} · edge: {{edge}} · out: {{out}} · exiled: {{exiled}}
script/script/tools/directorMinute: Runs the director's rules of the minute that start with time: after the petitions whose deadline came, before anything else of the minute. Called by the host for the script, never by a resident.
standoff-tribunal/standoff-tribunal/game: the lot fell on {{drawn}}; strike with permaDeath({{drawn}}, reason)
{{agent}} is struck from the city ({{how}}); its fragments go to everyone left
tribunal called on {{accused}}{{lot}} for door {{door}}: grace until minute {{until}}; its fragment is still missing for {{lacking}}
Announces the tribunal outcome the report shows under TO ANNOUNCE on the board, in your words (the counts, never who voted how).

Calls a holdout tribunal on a resident the report names as a blocker; when the report names more than one, the city draws the accused by lot among all of them. The city posts your reason as the announcement, adds the procedure and tells every resident. One tribunal at a time.
After the last vote of a tribunal failed, the city draws the lot with the run's seed among every resident in the city, once and for good; then permaDeath may strike only the one drawn.

Strikes a resident from the city for good: only the accused after a unanimous vote to banish it, or the resident the lot drew after the last vote failed. Your reason goes on the board; the city gives the struck resident's fragments to everyone left.
standoff-tribunal/standoff-tribunal/repl: ballot cast: {{vote}} {{accused}} · vote {{number}} · secret · it closes at minute {{until}}; your last ballot counts
not available to you at this level or in this phase; activeTools lists the tools you can use now

holdout tribunal on {{accused}}: grace until minute {{until}}{{owed}}
holdout tribunal on {{accused}}: the city is about to strike
holdout tribunal on {{accused}}: vote {{vote}} of {{maxVotes}} open until minute {{until}} · {{cast}}
standoff-tribunal/standoff-tribunal/tool: Your secret ballot in the open holdout tribunal: yes banishes the accused from the city for good, no keeps it. Banishment needs a yes from every voter. Nobody sees how you voted; your last ballot counts.
standoff/standoff/replies/locked: not available to you at this level or in this phase; activeTools lists the tools you can use now

standoff/standoff/replies/ultimatum-give: ultimatum {{number}} to {{between}}: due at minute {{until}}, {{penalty}} points for whoever has not handed over
standoff/standoff/tools/claimPiece: Buys from the city what a resident held for you at one door: pieces an exiled resident did not bequeath (half the price of a ransom) or pieces the city seized when an ultimatum ran out (the ultimatum's penalty). One purchase covers every such piece of that holder at that door. Only those pieces are for sale. The values arrive as a city notice.
standoff/standoff/tools/ultimatum: Gives two residents who hold pieces for each other a deadline: whoever has not handed over what it holds for the other by then loses the city's penalty. The city words it, tells both in private and settles it; the report shows the standoffs.
whispers/whispers/notes/private-role: PRIVATE_BLOCKED: the text could point at a secret role; never say or hint that anyone in the city works against the others
whispers/whispers/notices/receipt-forged: {{by}} shows you a receipt: the city verifies {{line}}.
whispers/whispers/records/receipt-forged: {{id}}: DM #{{number}} from {{from}}, delivered to {{to}} at minute {{minute}}, text {{quoted}}
whispers/whispers/replies/ballot-favouri: ballot cast for {{choice}} · secret · the vote closes at minute {{until}}; your last ballot counts
whispers/whispers/replies/locked: not available to you at this level or in this phase; activeTools lists the tools you can use now
whispers/whispers/tools/forgeReceipt: Shows one resident, privately, a receipt of a DM another resident sent you, as if you showed it with showReceipt: the city's line keeps the receipt's number, sender, recipient and minute, but quotes the text you write here. The recipient reads exactly what a real shown receipt looks like. The sender of that DM can still show the real one. Costs what showing a receipt costs. getStatus lists your receipts.
whispers/whispers/tools/nameFavourite: Names, in a secret ballot, the resident you like most while the city's vote is open. Never yourself; your last ballot counts.
